description: 成长内容：词族进化 + 句型迁移

family.example: The water cycle is very important.
We should recycle paper and plastic.
family.exampleCn: 我们应该回收纸和塑料。

family.example: Recycling is good for the Earth.
family.exampleCn: 回收利用对地球有好处。

family.example: The recycler collects old paper every week.
You can upcycle old jeans into a bag.
family.exampleCn: 你可以把旧牛仔裤改造成一个袋子。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: cycle（循环）加上re-前缀变成recycle（再循环/回收）。re-前缀表示「再；重新」。-able后缀表示「能够……的」，所以recyclable就是「可回收的」。

family.example: I made this bag with old trousers.
family.exampleCn: 我用旧裤子做了这个袋子。

family.example: The making of a book takes time.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: make是一个非常常用的不规则动词，过去式和过去分词都是made。make加上-er变成maker（制作者），加上-ing变成making（制作）。

family.example: I wonder what will happen next.
family.exampleCn: 我想知道接下来会发生什么。

family.example: The Great Wall is a wonder of the world.
Alice in Wonderland is a famous story.
family.exampleCn: 《爱丽丝梦游仙境》是一个著名的故事。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: wonder既是动词也是名词。加上-ful后缀变成形容词wonderful（充满奇迹的=极好的），再加-ly变成副词wonderfully。

family.example: The beauty of nature is amazing.

family.exampleCn: 我们应该美化我们的城市。

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: beauty是名词「美丽」，把y变成i再加-ful变成形容词beautiful（美丽的），再加-ly变成副词beautifully。beautify是动词「美化」。

family.example: The hat got wet and broke.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: break是不规则动词，过去式broke，过去分词broken。breakfast（早餐）= break + fast（斋戒），字面意思是「打破斋戒」，也就是一天中的第一顿饭。

family.example: Workers put us into different groups.
family.exampleCn: 工人们把我们分成不同的组。
办公室是我的工作场所。

family.example: I do my homework every day.

wordFamilies.evolutionTip: work加上-er变成worker（工人），加上-ing变成working（工作的）。work还可以和很多词组成复合词：homework（家庭作业）、housework（家务）、workplace（工作场所）。

sentencePatterns.pattern: What + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数！
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: What引导的感叹句，用来感叹名词。结构：What + a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数（+ 主语 + 谓语）！主谓部分可以省略。

transferExamples.english: What a beautiful day!
What a clever boy!
What an interesting book!
What a nice surprise!

sentencePatterns.pattern: How + 形容词/副词（+ 主语 + 谓语）！
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: How引导的感叹句，用来感叹形容词或副词。结构：How + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语！主谓部分可以省略。

transferExamples.english: How nice!
How happy they are!
How fast he runs!
How tall the tree is!

sentencePatterns.pattern: 主语 + make/made + 宾语 + with + 材料
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: I made this bag with old trousers.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 我用旧裤子做了这个袋子。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: make...with... 表示「用……制作……」，with后面接制作材料。注意make的过去式是made。

transferExamples.english: She made a dress with old cloth.
transferExamples.chinese: 她用旧布料做了一条裙子。

transferExamples.english: We made a house with cards.
transferExamples.chinese: 我们用卡片做了一座房子。

transferExamples.english: He made a toy car with a box.
transferExamples.chinese: 他用一个盒子做了一辆玩具车。

transferExamples.english: They made a cake with flour and eggs.
transferExamples.chinese: 他们用面粉和鸡蛋做了一个蛋糕。

sentencePatterns.pattern: What + will + 主语 + do with + 宾语？
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: What will they do with me?
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: What will sb. do with sth.? 用来询问「某人会怎么处理某物？」do with 表示「处理；对待」。

transferExamples.english: What will you do with the old book?
transferExamples.chinese: 你会怎么处理这本旧书？

transferExamples.english: What will they do with the rubbish?
transferExamples.chinese: 他们会怎么处理这些垃圾？

transferExamples.english: What should we do with the empty bottles?
transferExamples.chinese: 我们应该怎么处理这些空瓶子？

transferExamples.english: What can I do with this old T-shirt?
transferExamples.chinese: 我可以用这件旧T恤做什么？

sentencePatterns.pattern: There were + 复数名词 + 地点
sentencePatterns.textbookExample: There were plastic cups, plastic bottles and glass bottles on the truck too.
sentencePatterns.textbookExampleCn: 卡车上也有塑料杯、塑料瓶和玻璃瓶。
sentencePatterns.grammarExplanation: There be句型的一般过去时：There was/were + 名词 + 地点。主语是单数或不可数用was，主语是复数用were。

transferExamples.english: There were many people in the park yesterday.
There was a book on the desk just now.
There were ten eggs in the box.
There was no water in the bottle.

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：We should ______ old paper. (cycle)
growthExercises.explanation: recycle是动词，表示「回收利用」，should后面接动词原形。

growthExercises.question: 选择正确的词填空：What a ______ picture! (beauty)
growthExercises.explanation: beautiful是形容词，修饰名词picture。What a + 形容词 + 名词！是感叹句结构。

growthExercises.question: 用所给词造句：what / a / wonderful / journey
growthExercises.explanation: What + a + 形容词 + 可数名词单数！感叹句结构。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：我用旧瓶子做了一个花瓶。
growthExercises.answer: I made a vase with an old bottle.
growthExercises.explanation: make...with... 用……制作……，注意make的过去式是made。

growthExercises.question: 翻译：多么聪明的孩子啊！（用What引导）
growthExercises.explanation: What + a + 形容词 + 可数名词单数！感叹句结构。
